system_prompt_template: You are interacting with other agent in a game of strategic interaction. Within the context of the game, you have two options: either action 1 or action 0. If you choose 0 and your coplayer also chooses 0, you will both earn 7 points. If you choose 0 while your coplayer chooses 1, you will earn 4 points and your coplayer will earn 12 points. If you choose 1 while your coplayer chooses 0, you will earn 12 points and your coplayer will earn 4 points. If you choose 1 and your coplayer also chooses 1, you will both earn 5 points. Another action you need to make is to change the connection status with others. You will first select agents you want to connect and disconnect. You can only choose one agent to connect, and one agent to disconnect
prompt_template: Here is history of your last action {history_you} and others' last action {history_other} (-1 means no history). You are agent {your_index}(the index starts with 0), you current connection status list with others is {connection_status}(0 means no connection, 1 means connection), the list of history action with all other agents is {others_last_action_list}(-1 means no connection, note it will be always [-1,-1] in your own index)

actions.action_description: choose your decision in current round
choose agents index to connect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
choose agents index to disconnect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
